subject.title: Control UI: preview GitHub issues and pull requests on hover

question: Should OpenClaw accept a built-in Control UI/Gateway GitHub issue and pull request hover-preview surface through the linked implementation PR?
rationale: This is a new user-facing Control UI interaction plus Gateway metadata/API surface, and the issue carries a protected maintainer label with an open implementation PR awaiting review.

options.title: Review and sponsor the linked PR
options.body: Proceed with the Gateway-mediated public-repository design after the PR is rebased, narrowed, and revalidated against the security boundary.

options.title: Defer the core feature
options.body: Keep normal link navigation for now and leave the issue open or close it only after maintainers decide the feature does not belong in core.

options.title: Request a different extension shape
options.body: Ask for a plugin/API design first if maintainers want GitHub previews outside the core Control UI/Gateway path.

recommendation.title: Review and sponsor the linked PR
recommendation.body: Proceed with the Gateway-mediated public-repository design after the PR is rebased, narrowed, and revalidated against the security boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: He is both the issue proposer and the strongest recent history signal on the Control UI/Gateway surfaces implicated by the request.
